title: Ziplock bag organizer ruined by labels in four fonts & lousy magnetic hold for all hanging
text:
Ziplock bag organizer ruined by labels in four fonts & lousy magnetic hold for all hanging. This is what could have been a good four-compartment organizer for different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack) except that the labels etched into the black-painted bamboo are in a different font for each bag. In addition, the faceplate is magnetically attached and the magnets are NOT strong enough to hold the faceplate on when it is full of bags. Just a slight tap will have the top fall off. This is best used in a drawer only.

There are two holes in the back so this can be hung on the wall or be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it. Rubberized circles are NOT provided to keep it from sliding around or scratching a drawer or wall. Two screws with plastic mollies are provided for hanging.

Overall, this is a good organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets if I am using this inside a drawer. This is NOT a good organizer to hang. It is very attractive in black paint over bamboo. If the magnets held the front on stronger and all the labels looked like they were in the same font, this would have received 5 stars from me even without the addition of the rubberized circles. The current price of $19.99 ($29.99 minus $10) is certainly reasonably priced.

There are many other Ziplock bag organizer options available such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]] or an individual heavy plastic set like [[ASIN:B09THNTBGX this]]. For a cheaper unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]] but no screws are provided with that one. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a lot better than this one.
